rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０３１＿０２２I wanna go to Elan, but￥you and me just don't￥seem to click.
＊Eiji＊＠０３１＿０２３Wasn't there someone better￥to be your partner?
＊Narusawa＊＠００２＿００１Your grades are superb, but...￥you failed at the one thing that￥mattered: finding a partner.＝＠００２＿００２Getting along with others is￥also a vital part of qualifying.
＊Sakaki＊＠００２＿００３Right now, that's what you lack.＝＠００２＿００４I'm sorry, but we can't consider￥you qualified.
＊Narusawa＊＠００２＿００５We'll send the people we judge￥best qualified to Elan instead.
＊Narusawa＊＠００２＿００６Starting tomorrow, we'll be busy￥getting those who qualified￥ready to leave.
＊Sakaki＊＠００２＿００７We'll need all of you to￥help out. We're counting on you.
－　One Month Later　－＝－　The day the newly qualified￥　　　　leave for Elan　－
